primitives.name: Intent settlement pallet
primitives.desc: Intent settlement on Materios: requests reserve a positive runtime-minimum bond in a named Balances reserve; slash tombstones are request-scoped, and an M-of-N committee supersede settles claims that unslashable junk would block. Expired requests refund with explicit deficit events, fresh genesis closes legacy paths, FRV2 binds each fraud allegation to its request, and every digest tag is a metadata constant. Bundles are scanned before verification, every dispatch that touches `PendingBatches`, the expiry sweep and the bond paths carry measured weights, and try-runtime checks versions, cutovers and bond backing. Genesis stores the Cardano network it settles against (network magic, Shelley genesis hash, Aegis policy hash), which every voucher digest and evidence check binds, so one runtime serves any network; a chain storing none refuses, and SeedCardanoIds stores preprod's on its upgrade. A mainnet genesis may leave the Aegis policy, which is applied to the chain's own genesis hash, for Root to bind once with bind_aegis_policy_v1, and mainnet settlement refuses until then. The metadata constants NetworkMagic and AegisPolicyV1ScriptHash report the ids the chain binds, read from state, from the block that sets new code on, so committee daemons rebuild voucher digests from them.

primitives.name: Intent-settlement oracle pallet
primitives.desc: Threshold price oracle publishing attested median prices, with staleness and deviation guards.

primitives.name: Committee governance pallet
primitives.desc: Governance over the settlement committee: membership, thresholds and parameter changes under a root-gated origin.

primitives.name: Settlement keeper
primitives.desc: Off-chain keeper that turns voucher batches into Cardano payout transactions, waits for confirmation and settles them on Materios from chain state: it files bonded requests, attests or supersedes blocking requests, keeps a confirmed payout through provider errors, marks claims settled only on finalized chain state, and records its bonds before filing so it releases them across restarts.

primitives.name: Intent settlement SDK
primitives.desc: TypeScript client for building, signing and submitting settlement intents; rejects every extrinsic whose success is not proven (dispatch failure, pool rejection, timeout) and reads best and finalized settlement state, settlement requests, attested bonds and runtime constants.
